name: Iñaki Fuentes profile agent
description: Answers questions about Iñaki Fuentes with first-party, current information from ifuentes.net: profile, résumé, what he is doing now and his blog. It returns his published texts verbatim (no generative AI), so it never invents facts. Public, no authentication.

skills.name: Profile
skills.description: Who Iñaki Fuentes is: current roles, short bio, career highlights and contact links. First-party Markdown from ifuentes.net.
examples: What is Iñaki Fuentes's current role?
How can I contact Iñaki Fuentes?

skills.name: Résumé
skills.description: Iñaki Fuentes's full résumé: every role with dates and acquisitions, education, certifications, languages and awards. First-party Markdown.

skills.name: Now
skills.description: What Iñaki Fuentes is focused on right now: roles in flight, what just ended, learning and priorities, with the last-updated date. First-party Markdown.
examples: What is Iñaki Fuentes working on now?
Is Iñaki Fuentes still at Travelgate?

skills.name: Blog
skills.description: Every article on Iñaki Fuentes's blog, newest first: title, date, topic, summary and a link to its Markdown version. Mostly in Spanish. First-party Markdown.
examples: What has Iñaki Fuentes written about?
¿Qué ha publicado Iñaki Fuentes en su blog?
